seoDescription: Buy genuine smartphones in Nepal: Android phones and iPhones from trusted brands, with cash on delivery and delivery across the country.
seoContent:
## Buy smartphones in Nepal

Choosing a new phone comes down to how you use it: the camera you want, how long the battery needs to last, how much storage your photos and apps take, and how long you plan to keep it. Our phones section brings together Android phones and iPhones so you can compare them in one place.

## How to choose a phone

- Storage: 128 GB is a comfortable minimum today; choose 256 GB or more if you shoot a lot of video
- RAM: 8 GB or more keeps Android phones smooth for years of app updates
- Battery and charging: look at battery capacity and the supported charging speed, and use a charger that matches it
- Camera: compare the main sensor, ultra-wide and zoom options rather than megapixels alone
- Software support: brands differ in how many years of Android or iOS updates a model receives

## Phone registration in Nepal

Phones used in Nepal need their IMEI registered with the Nepal Telecommunications Authority's Mobile Device Management System (MDMS), otherwise a SIM may stop working in them. If you have a question about a particular model, contact us before you order.

faqs.question: Should I buy an Android phone or an iPhone?
faqs.answer: iPhones give you long software support, tight integration with other Apple devices and strong resale value. Android phones offer far more choice in price, design and features such as expandable storage or very fast charging. If you already use a Mac, iPad or Apple Watch, an iPhone fits in easily; otherwise Android gives you more options at every budget.

faqs.question: What is MDMS registration and does it affect me?
faqs.answer: MDMS is the Nepal Telecommunications Authority's system for registering phone IMEI numbers. Phones whose IMEI is not registered can be blocked from Nepali mobile networks. Ask us about a specific model if you want to confirm before buying.

faqs.question: Does the phone come with a charger in the box?
faqs.answer: It depends on the brand and model. Many recent phones, including iPhones, ship with only a cable. The product page lists what is included; if a charger is not in the box, see our chargers section for a compatible fast charger.

faqs.question: Can I pay for a phone with cash on delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cash on delivery is available for phones, as is payment with eSewa.

seoDescription: Shop genuine Android phones in Nepal from Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus and more. Compare models, pay on delivery, delivered nationwide.
seoContent:
## Buy Android phones in Nepal

Android phones cover every budget, from dependable everyday phones to flagships with some of the best cameras and displays available. That range is the main reason most Nepali buyers choose Android: you can pick exactly the features you care about.

## What to look for in an Android phone

- Processor: Snapdragon, Dimensity and Exynos chips vary a lot; a recent mid-range chip is plenty for social media, streaming and casual gaming
- RAM and storage: 8 GB RAM and 128 GB storage is a sensible starting point; check whether the model has a microSD slot
- Display: AMOLED panels give deeper blacks, and a 90 Hz or 120 Hz refresh rate makes scrolling smoother
- Battery: 5000 mAh is common and lasts a full day for most people; compare charging speeds too
- Updates: some brands now promise several years of Android and security updates, which keeps a phone safer for longer

All Android phones at 361 Gadgets are genuine retail units. Check the product page for the exact variant, colour and what is in the box.

faqs.question: How much RAM do I need in an Android phone?
faqs.answer: For everyday use, 6 to 8 GB is comfortable. If you play demanding games, keep many apps open or want the phone to stay quick for several years, 12 GB gives you more headroom.

faqs.question: Do Android phones support dual SIM in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Most Android phones support two SIM cards, either as two physical SIMs or one physical SIM plus eSIM. The product page lists the SIM configuration for each model.

faqs.question: Is fast charging safe for the battery?
faqs.answer: Yes, when you use the charger designed for the phone or a certified charger that supports the same standard. Phones manage charging speed and temperature themselves. Cheap uncertified chargers are the real risk.

faqs.question: Can I return an Android phone if I change my mind?
faqs.answer: Products can be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are unused, undamaged and in their original sealed packaging. Once a phone has been activated and used it may not be eligible.

seoDescription: Buy genuine iPhones in Nepal at 361 Gadgets. Original Apple iPhones with cash on delivery or eSewa, delivered across Nepal.
seoContent:
## Buy iPhones in Nepal

The iPhone is popular for good reasons: years of iOS updates, excellent video recording, strong privacy features and a resale value that holds up well. At 361 Gadgets we sell genuine Apple iPhones, so you know exactly what you are getting.

## Choosing the right iPhone

- Standard vs Pro: Pro models add a telephoto camera, a brighter ProMotion display and more advanced video features
- Storage: iPhones have no memory card slot, so choose storage carefully; 128 GB suits light users, 256 GB or more suits people who record video
- Size: the Plus and Pro Max models have bigger screens and the longest battery life
- Ecosystem: AirDrop, iCloud, Apple Watch and AirPods all work best together

## Buying an iPhone safely

In Nepal it is worth confirming that a phone is genuine and that its IMEI can be registered with the NTA's MDMS system. Our iPhones are original Apple units. The product page lists the model, storage, colour and what comes in the box.

faqs.question: Are your iPhones original Apple products?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every iPhone we sell is a genuine Apple device. We do not sell copies or refurbished units presented as new.

faqs.question: Does the iPhone come with a charger?
faqs.answer: Recent iPhones come with a USB-C cable but no power adapter. For fast charging, use a USB-C Power Delivery charger of 20 W or more, which you will find in our chargers section.

faqs.question: How much storage should I choose for an iPhone?
faqs.answer: iPhones cannot take a memory card, so buy the storage you will need for the life of the phone. 128 GB works for most people who use iCloud; choose 256 GB or 512 GB if you record a lot of 4K video or keep large offline libraries.

faqs.question: Will an iPhone work on Nepali networks?
faqs.answer: Yes, iPhones work on Nepal Telecom and Ncell networks, including 4G. The IMEI needs to be registered with the NTA's MDMS system, as with any phone used in Nepal.

seoDescription: Shop genuine tablets in Nepal: Apple iPads and Android tablets for study, work and entertainment, delivered across Nepal.
seoContent:
## Buy tablets in Nepal

A tablet sits between a phone and a laptop: big enough for comfortable reading, video calls, online classes and drawing, yet light enough to carry everywhere. We stock Apple iPads and Android tablets so you can choose the platform that suits you.

## How to choose a tablet

- Use: streaming and reading need little power; drawing, note-taking and editing benefit from a faster chip and stylus support
- Screen: 10 to 11 inches suits most people; larger screens are better for multitasking and drawing
- Storage: 64 GB fills up quickly with apps and offline video, so 128 GB is a safer choice
- Connectivity: Wi-Fi models are cheaper; cellular models let you use a SIM away from Wi-Fi
- Accessories: check keyboard and stylus compatibility before you buy

Browse iPads and Android tablets below, or open a product to see its full specifications.

faqs.question: Is a tablet good for online classes?
faqs.answer: Yes. A tablet with a good front camera, stereo speakers and at least 4 GB of RAM handles Zoom, Google Meet and Teams well. Add a keyboard case if you type a lot.

faqs.question: Should I choose an iPad or an Android tablet?
faqs.answer: iPads have excellent apps for study, drawing and productivity and receive long software support. Android tablets cost less for a similar screen size and work well with Google services and Android phones.

faqs.question: Can I use a SIM card in a tablet?
faqs.answer: Only in models labelled cellular, LTE or 5G. Wi-Fi-only models connect through Wi-Fi or a phone hotspot.

seoDescription: Buy genuine Android tablets in Nepal from Samsung, Xiaomi, Lenovo and more, ideal for study, streaming and work. Cash on delivery available.
seoContent:
## Buy Android tablets in Nepal

Android tablets give you a big, comfortable screen for YouTube, Netflix, reading, online classes and video calls, often for much less than a laptop. Many now support a stylus and keyboard covers, which makes them useful for note-taking and light work as well.

## What to look for

- Display: an 11-inch screen with a resolution above Full HD keeps text sharp; 90 Hz or higher feels smoother
- RAM: 4 GB is fine for streaming; 6 to 8 GB is better for multitasking and split-screen apps
- Storage: 128 GB, or a model with a microSD slot so you can add more
- Battery: tablets with 7000 mAh or more last a full day of classes or a long journey
- Speakers: quad speakers make a real difference for movies and calls
- Stylus: check whether a pen is included or sold separately

All Android tablets we sell are genuine. Specifications and what is in the box are listed on each product page.

faqs.question: Which Android tablet is best for students?
faqs.answer: Look for at least 4 GB of RAM, 64 to 128 GB of storage, a good front camera for online classes and long battery life. Stylus support is a bonus if you like handwritten notes.

faqs.question: Can I add storage to an Android tablet?
faqs.answer: Many Android tablets have a microSD card slot. Check the product specifications; if it has one, a fast microSD card from our memory cards section is an easy upgrade.

faqs.question: Do Android tablets get software updates?
faqs.answer: Yes, but how long depends on the brand. Some manufacturers promise several years of Android and security updates for their tablets, so it is worth comparing before you buy.

seoDescription: Buy genuine Apple iPads in Nepal at 361 Gadgets: iPad, iPad Air, iPad mini and iPad Pro, with cash on delivery and nationwide delivery.
seoContent:
## Buy iPads in Nepal

The iPad is the tablet most people compare everything else against. It is fast, has the best selection of tablet apps and works with the Apple Pencil and keyboard covers, so it can be a sketchbook, a notebook, a TV and a work device in one.

## Which iPad is right for you

- iPad: the everyday choice for streaming, reading, browsing and school work
- iPad mini: small enough to hold in one hand, great for reading and travel
- iPad Air: a faster chip and support for more accessories, ideal for students and creators
- iPad Pro: the most powerful iPad, with the best display, for professional drawing, photo and video work

## Before you buy

Check which Apple Pencil and keyboard models work with the iPad you choose, as compatibility varies between generations. Decide on storage up front too, because iPads cannot be upgraded later. Every iPad at 361 Gadgets is a genuine Apple product.

faqs.question: Which Apple Pencil works with my iPad?
faqs.answer: It depends on the iPad model and generation. Each product page lists the compatible Apple Pencil; if you are unsure, contact us with your iPad model before ordering an accessory.

faqs.question: Is an iPad good for drawing?
faqs.answer: Yes. With an Apple Pencil and apps such as Procreate, an iPad is one of the most popular digital drawing tools. The iPad Air and iPad Pro have the best screens and the lowest pen latency.

faqs.question: Should I get a Wi-Fi or cellular iPad?
faqs.answer: A Wi-Fi iPad is enough if you mostly use it at home, college or with your phone's hotspot. Choose a cellular model if you want mobile data on the iPad itself.

faqs.question: How much storage do I need on an iPad?
faqs.answer: 64 GB is tight once you install apps and download videos. 128 GB or 256 GB is a better choice for students and creators, since storage cannot be added later.
